title: Strict quotient expressions with actual horizontal transitions
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and morphisms $Z\xrightarrow h X\xrightarrow fY$ of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the coefficient sequence ringed site and its module category [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Write $\mathsf C(W)$ for its integer-indexed cochain complexes, $K_n$ for evaluation at positive exponent $n+1$, and $t_{m,n}$ for the horizontal transition of $K$, evaluated as a map to restriction of scalars. Write $\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)$ for the direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and $g^*P$ for termwise inverse image on the sequence site [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. For a finite list $N: \operatorname{Fin}(r)\to\mathsf C(Y)$, including $r=0$, define $\operatorname{Generated}_{h,f,N}(W,K)$ as the least collection containing each $N_i$ at $Y$, the degree-zero sequence-ring unit at each of $Y,X,Z$, and closed under total tensor on a common scheme and inverse image along exactly $f,h,f\circ h$ (in scheme-composition notation $Z\to Y$). Every constructor uses the actual sequence-complex functor, so its horizontal transitions are induced, not separately supplied. Finally $\operatorname{Good}(K,n)$ means that $K_n$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and each of its terms is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. The induced-transition predicates state the actual horizontal formulas in each degree: tensor sends a local total-summand generator $x\otimes y$ to $t(x)\otimes t(y)$, and pullback sends the inverse-image unit generator of $x$ to that of $t(x)$. The coefficient quotient on a scalar multiple is already the semilinearity of the horizontal map.

Use these strict quotient complexes, levels, transitions and pullbacks, the canonical ordinary and derived quotient-extension functors and normalized coefficient calculi of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and the ordinary finite-coefficient pullback and its adjunction-unit generators of [def-pur-integral-finite-pullback]. For a strict complex $K$ at $W$, a normalized coefficient calculus $D$, $n\leq m$, and a proof that $K_m$ is K-flat, define $\operatorname{AdjointModel}(K,D,m,n)$ to mean that there is a chain isomorphism $a:K_m\otimes_{B_m}B_n\simeq K_n$ whose ordinary adjunct is the actual horizontal transition $t_{m,n}$, and whose localization, preceded by the canonical K-flat derived-extension comparison, is the derived adjunct of that same transition. Require explicitly that $a(b\otimes x)=b\,t_{m,n}(x)$ and $a^{-1}(b\,t_{m,n}(x))=b\otimes x$ on all local sections in every degree. The permitted-arrow predicate contains exactly $f,h,f\circ h$ as maps $X\to Y,Z\to X,Z\to Y$. Define $\operatorname{PullbackModel}(g,K,n)$ as existence of the identification $(g^*K)_n\simeq g_n^*(K_n)$ carrying the actual sequence inverse-image unit generator to the actual finite inverse-image unit generator. Define $\operatorname{PullbackComputes}(g,K,n)$ to mean that the comparison of every universal left-derived pair for this ordinary finite pullback is invertible on $K_n$ [def-pur-integral-finite-pullback]. The tensor and pullback transitions themselves are already the actual horizontal maps in the operations defined above, rather than additional map choices. These representative conditions do not assume their validity.

Write $\alpha^K_{m,n}$ for the derived adjunct of the actual horizontal transition (including the exact-localization transport for scalar restriction), and $a^K_{m,n}$ for its ordinary chain adjunct. On Good representatives, let $c_n$ be the localization of the ordinary evaluation/tensor comparison followed by the finite K-flat tensor-model isomorphism [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define the tensor-adjoint equation as
$$T_{m,n}(c_m)\,;\,\mu_{m,n}\,;\,(\alpha^U_{m,n}\otimes^{\mathbf L}\alpha^V_{m,n})=\alpha^{\operatorname{Tot}(U\otimes V)}_{m,n}\,;\,c_n,$$
where semicolon denotes diagrammatic composition and $\mu$ is the canonical strong monoidal quotient-extension comparison. For a permitted inverse image $g:W'\to W$, write $g_j^*$ for the recorded finite ordinary module pullback, including its canonical constant-ring comparison. Pin the evaluation/pullback chain identifications $e_j:(g^*K)_j\simeq g_j^*K_j$ by the actual inverse-image unit generators. Pin the scalar-change chain isomorphism $\chi:T^{\mathrm{ord}}_{W',m,n}g_m^*K_m\simeq g_n^*T^{\mathrm{ord}}_{W,m,n}K_m$ by
$$\chi(1\otimes g_m^*(x))=g_n^*(1\otimes x)$$
in every degree, on every source-site object; linearity includes every scalar multiple. Define the pullback-adjoint equation to require these pinned chain isomorphisms and
$$T^{\mathrm{ord}}_{W',m,n}(e_m)\,;\,\chi\,;\,g_n^*(a^K_{m,n})=a^{g^*K}_{m,n}\,;\,e_n.$$
Together with AdjointModel and PullbackComputes this is the canonical K-flat representative formulation of the derived inverse-image adjoint formula [lem-sfb-kflat-scalar-comparison-normalization]. No equality between the independent site and coefficient universes is required.
